title: Immune-angiogenic crosstalk in glioblastoma: Mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) remains the most aggressive and therapeutically challenging primary brain tumor and is characterized by strong heterogeneity, rapid progression, and poor clinical outcomes. Accumulating evidence indicates that the immune-angiogenic axis is a major contributor to GBM progression and therapeutic resistance, coordinating dynamic interactions...
